product_name: Bajaj Life Future Wealth Gain IV
regulatory_descriptor: A Unit-Linked Non-Participating Individual Life Savings Insurance Plan
key_benefits: Maturity Benefit equal to the Fund Value on survival to the maturity date (market-linked, not guaranteed)

Death Benefit — higher of (Prevailing Sum Assured or Regular Premium Fund Value) plus higher of (Top-up Sum Assured or Top-up Premium Fund Value), subject to a minimum Guaranteed Death Benefit of 105% of Total Premiums Paid till date of death
Loyalty Additions added to the Regular Premium Fund Value at each 5-year interval from the 15th policy year onwards (all due premiums paid)
Choice of 2 investment portfolio strategies and multiple funds
Option to take death & maturity benefit in instalments (Settlement Option)
Option to choose high life-insurance cover via a sum-assured multiplier
Option to reduce regular/limited premium and to change premium payment term/frequency
riders_available: Bajaj Life Linked Accident Protection Rider II
Bajaj Life Linked New Critical Illness Benefit Rider

If WOP rider is triggered, on termination the present value of future WOP installments (discounted at 4% p.a.) is payable.

mandatory_disclosures_present: ULIP market-risk statement (investment subject to capital-market risk; policyholder solely responsible for decisions)

claims_marketing_must_support: Maturity Benefit is the Fund Value — a market-linked, non-guaranteed amount; any return figure must be shown as illustrative (e.g. 4% and 8%) and labelled 'not guaranteed'.

The ONLY guaranteed element is the 105%-of-Total-Premiums-Paid floor on the Death Benefit; Loyalty Additions are conditional on all due premiums paid and an in-force (not discontinued/paid-up) policy and start only from the 15th policy year.
Any 'high cover' claim is tied to the chosen sum-assured multiplier and the minimum/maximum sum-assured criteria.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT describe fund value, returns or maturity proceeds as 'guaranteed', 'assured' or 'fixed' — this is a unit-linked plan and the policyholder bears all investment/market risk.
Do NOT use 'bonus' language — the plan is non-participating; there are no bonuses.
Do NOT imply liquidity in the first 5 years — ULIP lock-in applies.
Do NOT present Loyalty Additions as immediate or unconditional — they begin from the 15th policy year and are not paid on Top-up premiums or on discontinued/paid-up policies.
Do NOT state tax benefits as assured — always carry the 'subject to prevailing tax laws' caveat.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Unit-Linked Non-Participating Individual Life Savings Insurance Plan'
ULIP market-risk disclosure: investment in ULIPs is subject to risks associated with the capital markets; the policyholder is solely responsible for his/her investment decisions
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document / benefit illustration for full terms, charges and exclusions
